beliefs: f(x) = reverse(x) with 'I' inserted at position floor(len(x)/2) in the reversed string [E1, E2, E3]
For odd-length strings the 'I' sits at the middle index of the reversed string, e.g. 'abc'->'cbIa' [E3]
For even-length strings the 'I' sits at index len/2 of the reversed string, e.g. 'abcd'->'dcIba' [E3]
Empty string maps to 'I' (len 0, insert at 0) [E1]
All characters (case, digits, symbols, spaces, tabs) are preserved and reversed unchanged [E1, E2]
notes: The 'I' is not appended but inserted at the middle of the reversed string (index len//2). Verified against all E1-E3 outputs.
